snippet.title: Streets of Rogue 2 - Official 'Paradise' Trailer | tinyBuild Connect 2025
snippet.description:
Wishlist Streets of Rogue 2 on Steam: https://tblink.co/StreetsOfRogue2
Development Roadmap: https://tblink.co/SoR2_Roadmap 

This trailer shows Streets of Rogue 2's progress in the past couple of months.

A quick look at:
- The worldbuilding progress (new biomes, chunks)
- New animals
- Improved UI
- More crazy-ass situations that will be possible in the game
...and more.

The game is coming to Steam Early Access in 2025. Not before it's ready, but certainly before GTA VI. Hopefully.

Join the community on:
🔗DISCORD: https://discord.gg/streetsofrogue
